model_output.verdict: A Staff Accountant with a clear progression, but too little detail about the accounting work.
write_up: You moved from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply, and your resume points clearly toward staff accounting. It's common to describe accounting work as a list of duties, but this version won't stand out in a pile: a recruiter can't tell how much work you handle or what your close involves.

The line about preparing journal entries and account reconciliations is the best model because it names two concrete pieces of accounting work. Your dates, accounting degree and systems are easy to find; what's missing is a sense of the work behind those tools.

Let's start with the month-end close line in your current role. Add the tasks you handle and a measure you can support, then do the same for the audit and fixed asset work. A short description of Rivermark can also give a recruiter context for the business.
